---
title: "Lab 09 — Mechanisms"
output: learnr::tutorial
runtime: shiny_prerendered
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(tidyverse)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("../R/lab_submission.R")
mech <- read_csv("data/mechanism_diplomatic_contact.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
lab_meta <- list(id = "lab09", title = "Mechanisms")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "In this file, diplomatic contact is associated with…",
  q2 = "The contact coefficient in the outcome regression shrinks when trust is added. That pattern…",
  q3 = "An effect and a mechanism are…",
  q4 = "Name one rival story for \"trust is the mechanism\" besides mediation."
)
```

## What you will do

See the three-regression pattern and refuse to call it proof. Download the `.txt`.

```{r three, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=8}
coef(lm(support_for_cooperation ~ diplomatic_contact, data = mech))[["diplomatic_contact"]]
coef(lm(trust_in_foreign_partner ~ diplomatic_contact, data = mech))[["diplomatic_contact"]]
coef(lm(
  support_for_cooperation ~ diplomatic_contact + trust_in_foreign_partner,
  data = mech
))[["diplomatic_contact"]]
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("Higher support for cooperation (about +0.8) and higher trust (about +0.8).", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Lower trust and lower support."),
  answer("No association with either."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Is consistent with a trust pathway and also with other stories. It is not proof.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Proves that trust mediates the effect."),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("Different claims. Knowing that T moved Y is not knowing how.", correct = TRUE),
  answer("The same claim, written twice."),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

```{r q4}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q4"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "Confounder, bad control, or measurement overlap.",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

## Submit

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")
shiny::downloadButton("download_txt", "Download submission .txt")
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = shiny::reactiveValuesToList(learnr::get_tutorial_state()),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
